_doku: Reporting-currency hand table (2026-10-30, hold since 2026-10-31). Read by lib/reporting-currency-hand-table.js inside mapYahooToCanonical and _convertSnapshotToUSD (pull-yahoo.js).

Row = a ticker for which Yahoo omits financialCurrency while the filing proves another currency than the trading currency. Without the row the pull falls back to the trading currency (ccyAmbiguous) and stores the statements under the wrong label: amounts and every ratio against the market cap are off, growth and margins stay right.
The filled currency then runs through the ordinary conversion like any other foreign filer. A currency Yahoo delivers and that agrees with the row wins and needs no bound.

A row proves its currency up to provenThrough, the newest statement period the quoted filing covers. If Yahoo names another currency, or delivers an amount for a later period while still naming none, all reporting-currency amounts are withheld (financialMissing, meta._reportingCcyHandTableConflict), the firm is re-pulled every run, counted in n_reporting_ccy_held of the manifest, and scripts/ccy-alarm-gate.js turns the data run red. To end it: read the new report, then move provenThrough with its source, or change or remove the row.

PSQL.source: Der Konzernabschluss steht in Euro; Yahoo nennt keine Berichtswährung, deshalb standen der Umsatz 2025 von 16.468 Tsd. EUR und alle weiteren Beträge als US-Dollar im Datenpaket.
